target: Freenove FNK0052 full 18-DOF stock walking mechanism, 2-DOF head, 4x18650, Raspberry Pi 4B
headline: Illustrative mass estimate conditional on CAD and MG996R-like 55g servo analogue: 1.80 kg nominal, scenario envelope ~1.64-2.08 kg. NOT a measured confidence interval.
completeness: CAD geometry available, masses to be calibrated. Do not set physics-validation gates to true from this estimate.

calculations.method: sum(count * per_group_mass_scenario_kg); rows with CAD body masses REPLACE model masses rather than adding again.

rows.method: CAD base_link_2 0.233494 kg; tolerance of model materials (not measured). Includes battery holders and acrylic; excludes cells/actual Pi/shield.
Each coxa model (0.082623 kg) depicts TWO big servos + brackets. MG996R (55g) is only a similar-sized proxy, NOT confirmed stock. Nominal 2*55g + 10g brackets; uncertainty from servo and material.
Non-servo femur plates derived from URDF 0.0144792 kg; actual material density unknown.
Each tibia model (0.0425984 kg) depicts ONE big servo + tip/plate. Nominal 55g analogue + 10g hardware. No extra servo outside this group.
CAD neck 0.0239856 + face 0.0345134 kg; 2 small servo meshes already present. Not measured.
Cells excluded from stock kit. 45g example is Samsung INR18650-25R, compatible-size high-current class, not claim of exact user-selected SKU.
Nominal Pi 4B 46g (official magazine); additional heatsink/cables can increase actual. This scenario is only stock_pi4.
Explicit allowance for shield, IMU module, cable harness, omitted screws/standoffs; range is engineering judgment, not a measurement. Avoid counting built-in holders/head plates twice.

warnings: CAD origin includes 18 large and 2 small servo VISUAL parts. Adding 20 servo masses to 1.130 kg double-counts them.
Large servo is unknown in the real kit; MG996R 55 g is an analogue and its stall torque is not a continuous torque.
CAD masses reflect unknown CAD material/density, not physical weighing. Some mass is hidden in servo geometries and misassigned to rotating parts.
Exact centre of gravity cannot be asserted until batteries/Pi/shield are placed and servo mounting frames validated.
Range is sensitivity to assumed component masses, NOT a probabilistic 95%-CI or guaranteed physical mass.
2.66 kg vendor/marketplace listing is likely package weight with tools/box; not established as assembled robot weight.
The custom ESP32 variant must be modelled separately after its power, sensors and mounting are chosen.
no_support_contact: User explicitly chose open sources/community reverse engineering; do not contact vendor.
